title: Modifier
description: A single modifier definition that can roll on item instances. See Item Instancing and Item and NPC levels in the vault.

mod_id.title: Mod ID
mod_id.description: Stable identifier referenced in rolled item instances. Use snake_case. Never rename — change cascades through every existing rolled item.

target.title: Stat target
target.description: Which EffectiveStats field this mod feeds.

kind.title: Stacking bucket
kind.description: Effect engine stacking bucket. flat adds to the base; percent_additive sums with other additive mods; percent_multiplicative compounds with other multiplicative mods.

low.title: Roll low
low.description: Low end of the value range at item level 1 with level_scaling 1.0. Scaled at roll time by level_curve(item.level) × level_scaling.

high.title: Roll high
high.description: High end of the same range. Must be ≥ low.

level_scaling.title: Level scaling factor
level_scaling.description: How strongly the roll range scales with item level. 1.0 = normal. 0.0 = doesn't scale (use for qualitative mods). 2.0 = steep (very impactful at high level).

tier_eligibility.title: Eligible rarity tiers
tier_eligibility.description: Which item rarities can roll this mod. At least one required.

when.title: Optional condition (raw JSON)
when.description: Effect-engine Condition that gates when this mod's bonus applies. Hand-edit JSON for now — discriminated-union form rendering is a follow-on slice. Example: {"type":"self_hp_below_pct","pct":30}
